name: Frictionless Data Package
summary: Open specification for describing and packaging datasets with structured metadata (schema, provenance, licensing), enabling consistent assessment of a dataset's fitness for a given use.

name: EasyEdit
summary: Easy-to-use knowledge editing and model-editing framework for LLMs, implementing memory-based, meta-learning, locate-then-edit and parameter-efficient methods, with dedicated multilingual (CKnowEdit) and multimodal (MiniGPT-4, BLIP-2, LLaVA-OneVision, Qwen2-VL) editors.
